purpose: Concept previews for Funke editor file icon families; not installed.

concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished landscape design proposal board for a family of file icons for the Funke game engine editor. This is a visual concept presentation, not a screenshot of working software. Canvas approximately 1536x1024. Solid dark charcoal background #202226, quiet neutral typography. Elegant but practical professional desktop developer-tool design. Exactly THREE primary icons in one horizontal row, equal optical size and generous even spacing: C# source file, plain text file, engine scene file. Under them the exact extension labels ".cs", ".txt", ".scene", and smaller filenames "Player.cs", "Notes.txt", "World.scene". Icons roughly 180-220 pixels tall in this presentation. At bottom a single narrow darker asset-browser preview strip repeating the same three designs as smaller thumbnail icons with those filenames; small previews must faithfully match large icons. Maintain green for C# (#77C966), cool light slate/grey for text, blue (#68A6F5) for scene. Distinguish types through symbols as well as color. C# glyph must be clearly "C#" or recognizable code braces; TXT glyph three clean unequal horizontal text bars; SCENE glyph a clear simple scene/world composition with ground plane plus small cube and a tiny horizon, not a home, not a photo, not a lone prefab cube. All three should feel from the exact same extendable family, suitable for eventually dozens of file extensions. Keep glyphs bold, visual mass balanced, silhouettes easy to recognize in a compact asset browser. Precise clean edges, smooth modern UI artwork (not pixel art), no noisy textures, no micro ornaments, no gradients in the backdrop, no giant drop shadows, no neon glow, no watermark, no fake branding logos. No extra asset types. Concept 1 title exact: "01 / PRÄZISE DOKUMENTE". Style: refined flat 2D file documents, upright with a small elegantly clipped/folded top-right corner. Tall file silhouette, softly rounded lower corners. Restrained solid category color body, a darker single-tone fold, high contrast off-white large central symbols. No 3D bevel, no shine, no photorealism. A small bottom baseline detail may anchor the glyph, but avoid text inside the icon beyond C#. Strong geometrical proportions and crisp negative space. This should look like exceptionally well-crafted native editor icons, not generic stock clipart. Small caption under title exact: "Klare Formen · starke Lesbarkeit".
